def qnow():
    _,p=current();return np.array([p[n] for n in spec['kinematics']['joint_names']])
def downward(angle):
    x=np.array([np.cos(angle),np.sin(angle),0.]);z=np.array([0.,0.,-1.]); y=np.cross(z,x)
    return R.from_matrix(np.column_stack([x,y,z])).as_quat().tolist()
def solve(side,pose):
    m,p=current();bp=m['proprio']['now'][28:35]
    ans=r.ik({side+'_eef_link':pose},seed=qnow(),base_pose=bp)
    print('IK',ans)
    return ans

def goto(side,pose,grip=None,execute=True):
    ans=solve(side,pose)
    if not ans.get('ok'):return ans
    if not execute:return ans
    return driveq(ans['q'],side,grip)
def driveq(q,side=None,grip=None):
    a=joints();b=a.copy();b[3:14]=q[:11];b[16:23]=q[11:]
    if grip is not None:
        b[14:16] = (.07 if grip else 0) if side=='left' else b[14:16]
        b[23:25] = (.07 if grip else 0) if side=='right' else b[23:25]
    n=max(30,int(np.max(abs(b[3:]-a[3:]))/.015))
    A=np.linspace(a,b,n); A[:,14:16]=b[14:16];A[:,23:25]=b[23:25]
    A=np.vstack([A,np.tile(b,(30,1))])
    return act(A,note='IK joint path')
PY
